# MetaHumotonic

> Semantic Web Server Platform — Knowledge Graph-native infrastructure

MetaHumotonic is a personal semantic infrastructure operated by Gyeongjun Ra (bhgman).
It hosts a Neo4j Knowledge Graph with 547K+ nodes and 1M+ relations across 13 domains,
managed through 18 AI skills built on the APT (Agent Process Template) methodology.

## Services

- Neo4j KG: Graph database with 547K+ nodes, 1M+ relations
- PostgreSQL: Relational data (maindb, n8n workflows)
- Redis: Caching and pub/sub messaging
- MongoDB: Document storage
- MinIO: S3-compatible object storage
- Kafka: Event streaming (KRaft mode)
- n8n: Workflow automation
- Traefik: Reverse proxy and load balancer

## API Endpoints

- /api/stats.json — KG statistics (nodes, relations, domains, skills)
- /api/domains.json — 13 knowledge domains with node counts
- /api/skills.json — 18 AI skills with descriptions

## Knowledge Domains

1. Personal — Identity, biography, philosophy
2. Math & Physics — Pure mathematics, theoretical physics
3. Computer Science — Programming, algorithms, type theory
4. Artificial Intelligence — ML, neural networks, AI safety
5. Infrastructure — Server ops, K8s, Docker, DevOps
6. Literature & Writing — Creative writing, poetry
7. Religion & Theology — Comparative theology, scripture
8. APT Methodology — Semantic software engineering
9. Philosophy — Epistemology, metaphysics, ethics
10. Community — Open source, collaboration
11. Business & Career — Strategy, development
12. Health & Biology — Biomedical, cognitive science
13. Streaming & Media — Live streaming, content creation

- /apt — APT v24 orchestrator (SA→SP→ST→SCW)
- /apt-sa — SemanticAnchor: project bootstrap

- /apt-st — SemanticTwin: contract crystallization
- /apt-scw — SourceCodeWorld: TDD implementation

- /harness — Architecture-as-constraint

### Research

### Operations
